claim_ceiling: This is a cross-check reconciliation between two independent re-scores of the SAME rebuilt bytes. It is NOT an acceptance of the frontier's DO-NOT-SERVE-UNCHANGED verdict (the frontier is not independently accepted), it does NOT supersede the accepted DO-NOT-SERVE order on packet 38839347028, it does NOT meet either frozen absolute bar (geometry 0/3 bundles at 11/11; label support 1.0 is over 5 ISSUED rows with 60 abstentions, not an absolute pass), it changes no frozen artifact and adds no threshold, and it leaves human_gate_ready=false.
